31 January 2023

## Circular to Intermediaries Submission of BCAN-CID Mapping File

## for the Hong Kong Investor Identification Regime

Reference is made to the Circular dated 12 December 2022 regarding the upcoming launch of the Hong Kong Investor Identification Regime (HKIDR).

## Submission of BCAN-CID Mapping File

To prepare for the launch of the HKIDR on 20 March 2023 , Relevant Regulated Intermediaries 1 (RRIs) are reminded that they are allowed to submit the BCAN-CID Mapping File that contains Broker-to-Client Assigned Number (BCAN) and client identification data (CID) of their clients (i.e. the real data but not the test data) to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (SEHK) from 19 December 2022 onwards. The submission can be conducted via SEHK's Electronic Communication Platform (ECP) web interface and/or ECP (SFTP) interface. RRIs are strongly advised to submit the BCAN-CID Mapping File as soon as possible, so as to allow sufficient time to verify the data and rectify any error encountered during the file submission process. Please refer to SEHK's Circular dated 12 December 2022 for details of the requirements.

## Compliance  with  applicable  data  privacy  laws  including  Personal  Data  (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO)

Before submitting an individual client's BCAN and CID to SEHK, RRIs should have obtained the  necessary  written  or  other  forms  of  express  consent  from  the  individual  regarding  the collection, storage, processing and use of personal data in relation to such client's BCANs and CIDs under the HKIDR in accordance with the SFC's requirements and all applicable data privacy laws including the PDPO. Please refer to the SFC's Circular dated 13 September 2021 for details.

## Securities and Futures Commission

1  RRIs refer to SFC-licensed corporations and registered institutions subject to the HKIDR pursuant to paragraph 5.6 of the SFC's Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the SFC as set out in the Appendix C to the SFC's consultation conclusions paper issued in August 2021.
